item.title: Second Half Explosion Leads Men's Basketball Past North Florida
Counts Sets Freshman Single-Season Blocks Record; Women’s Basketball Uses Fourth Quarter Surge to Sail Past Ospreys
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Women's Basketball team shot 52% from the field and used an 18-10 fourth quarter to defeat the University of North Florida, 73-65, Saturday afternoon inside Allen Arena.

item.title: Bisons Post Historic Performances at Lenny Lyles Invitational
item.description: LOUISVILLE, Ky. – Lipscomb Track & Field delivered a historic two-day performance at the Lenny Lyles Invitational, highlighted by multiple event wins, school records, NCAA-leading marks, and personal bests across sprints, hurdles, distance, and field events at the Norton Healthcare Sports & Learning Center.

item.title: Men's Tennis Cruises to Saturday Win over the Governors
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Men's Tennis team rolled to a 6-1 victory over Austin Peay State University in the team's home indoor opener from the Ensworth Tennis Center on Saturday.

item.title: Women’s Tennis Rallies in Singles as Bovio, Bobrovnikova Secure Victory over MTSU
item.description: MURFREESBORO, Tenn. – After losing the doubles point and seeing themselves down 3-2 late in singles, the Lipscomb University Women's Tennis team rallied late thanks to the hands of Serafima Bobrovnikova and Martina Bovio to defeat Middle Tennessee State University, 4-3, Sunday afternoon from the Adams Tennis Center.

item.title: Men's Tennis Defeats Alabama A&M to Finish Weekend Undefeated
item.description: NASHVILLE – Less than 24 hours after taking down Austin Peay State University, the Lipscomb University Men's Tennis team finishes off the weekend with a 5-2 victory of Alabama A&M University on Sunday afternoon inside the Ensworth Tennis Center.

item.title: Perlov Garners ASUN Player of the Week Honor
item.description: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. – The Atlantic Sun Conference announced on Tuesday afternoon that senior Facundo Perlov was chosen as the ASUN Men's Tennis Player of the Week.

item.title: Paladi Secures First ASUN Weekly Honor of 2026; Fifth of Career
item.description: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. – Lipscomb University senior Sofiia Paladi was selected as the Atlantic Sun Conference Women's Tennis Player of the Week for the first time in the 2025-26 season and the fifth of her career.

item.title: Women's Golf Finishes Second in First Tournament of the Spring
item.description: PALM CITY, Fla. – Lipscomb Women's Golf kicked off its 2026 spring season with a second-place finish at the Advance Golf Partners Collegiate hosted by UNCG. The Bisons tied host UNCG for second and finished behind only Virginia Tech, ranked No. 37 in the country.

item.title: Men's Golf Opens Spring at The Sea Best Invitational
item.description: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. – Lipscomb Men's Golf opened up its spring 2026 season at the Sea Best Invitational hosted by Jacksonville, finishing seventh in a field of 14 teams. Included in the field were ranked opponents No. 5 Florida and No. 34 Texas A&M, along with ASUN foes FGCU, North Florida, North Alabama, and Jacksonville. The tournament was shortened to two rounds due to cold, windy conditions.
